supporting_ids: s2:A Multi-instrument Study of the 2018 Hard-state-only Outburst of H1743-322
rationale: The papers 'A Multi-instrument Study of the 2018 Hard-state-only Outburst of H1743-322', 'Searching for quantum-gravity footprint around stellar-mass black holes', and '2017 Outburst of H 1743-322: AstroSat and Swift View' provide insights into the accretion flow and geometry in the low/hard state, contributing evidence relevant to the extent of the accretion disk.
